Wellington, Aug 26: India’s upcoming multi-format tour of New Zealand has driven record early demand, with 26,000 tickets sold in the first 48 hours of the host board’s pre-sale.
The 12-match tour, beginning in October, has emerged as the biggest draw in New Zealand Cricket’s Cricket Nation members’ pre-sale, which went live on Monday.
Meanwhile, the white-ball matches at Auckland’s Eden Park have led the way in terms of tickets sold, while strong demand has also been reported from Christchurch

stories.title: India tour of Sri Lanka: Dinusha denies India's win as SL hold on to a draw
stories.extract:
Cricket
India tour of Sri Lanka: Dinusha denies India's win as SL hold on to a draw
All-rounder smashes third ton of the series while the visitors won series 1-0
CHENNAI: When India started the day needing four wickets to dismiss Sri Lanka in their second essay, the task may have seemed simple. However, it was anything but. Led by Sonal Dinusha's valiant effort, he scored his third century of the series, Sri Lanka put up a defiant front, denying India a chance of finishing with a 2-0 scoreline.

stories.title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan 2027 (Open Call)
stories.extract: The Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) has opened applications for its FY2027 Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan, offering outstanding early-career researchers an opportunity to conduct research at leading Japanese universities and research institutions. The fellowship supports international collaboration by enabling highly qualified researchers from around the world to work with host researchers in Japan through the Standard and Short-term (PE) fellowship programmes.
